CREATE TABLE ml_feed_state (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	capacity INTEGER DEFAULT '100000' NOT NULL, 
	retained BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	published BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	overflow_skipped BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	pruned BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	last_gap_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ml_feed_state CHECK (id=1 AND capacity>0 AND retained>=0 AND published>=0 AND overflow_skipped>=0 AND pruned>=0)
)


CREATE TABLE ml_models (
	model_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	model_version VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	manifest_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	feature_version VARCHAR(40), 
	detector VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'telemetry_anomaly' NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'DEMO' NOT NULL, 
	score_semantics VARCHAR(256), 
	score_upper_bound FLOAT, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	heartbeat_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	diagnostic VARCHAR(80), 
	PRIMARY KEY (model_id, model_version), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ml_model_status CHECK (status IN ('available','unavailable','disabled','version_conflict'))
)


CREATE TABLE ml_observations (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	key_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sequence_number BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	mongo_confirmed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_ml_observation UNIQUE (device_id, key_epoch, sequence_number), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ml_observation_numbers CHECK (key_epoch>0 AND sequence_number>0)
)

CREATE INDEX ix_ml_feed_order ON ml_observations (mongo_confirmed_at, id)

CREATE TABLE ml_anomaly_events (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	observation_id VARCHAR(36), 
	device_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	key_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sequence_number BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	model_id VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	model_version VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, 
	feature_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	detector VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'telemetry_anomaly' NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	diagnostic VARCHAR(80), 
	score FLOAT, 
	threshold FLOAT, 
	is_anomaly BOOLEAN, 
	evaluated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	prepare_ms FLOAT, 
	inference_ms FLOAT, 
	delivery_ack_lag_seconds FLOAT, 
	attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	available_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	claim_token VARCHAR(36), 
	lease_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_ml_evaluation_identity UNIQUE (device_id, key_epoch, sequence_number, model_id, model_version), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ml_event_numbers CHECK (key_epoch>0 AND sequence_number>0 AND attempts>=0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ml_event_status CHECK (status IN ('processing','retry','ok','warmup','unknown_device','out_of_order','invalid_history','dead','feed_expired')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ml_scored_event CHECK (status!='ok' OR (score IS NOT NULL AND threshold IS NOT NULL AND is_anomaly IS NOT NULL AND evaluated_at IS NOT NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ml_finite_score CHECK (score IS NULL OR (score>=0 AND score<'Infinity'::float8)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_ml_finite_threshold CHECK (threshold IS NULL OR (threshold>=0 AND threshold<'Infinity'::float8)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(observation_id) REFERENCES ml_observations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE INDEX ix_ml_event_claim ON ml_anomaly_events (model_id, model_version, status, available_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_ml_event_history ON ml_anomaly_events (device_id, evaluated_at)
